name: Sinn6r
description:
'''Sinn6r''' (stylized in uppercase) is an English rapper and record producer from South East London, England. Associated with the [[UK underground rap]] scene, his music has been characterised as featuring "trap-inspired hellscapes" and cadences influenced by [[Drill music|American drill music]]. 

Sinn6r has been credited with popularising the use of sliding 808s in the UK underground rap scene with his studio album ''[[Federal (SINN6R album)|#FEDERAL]],'' building on a technique initially developed by [[808Melo]]''.'' He has collaborated with artists such as [[Lancey Foux]], [[EsDeeKid]] and Rico Ace, and is signed to Lizzy Records.
